_meta.note: Source-of-truth columns (Test Scenario ID/Description, Test Case ID/Description, Precondition, Test data, Expected Result) are never modified by automation. Automation only ever writes back Actual Result / Status / Comments / Date Tested in the actual .xlsx via cypress/utils/excelUpdater.js.
_meta.criticalFinding: The local designerex-consumer-main source checked into this repo does NOT match what's actually deployed to DEV (designerex.gurzu.net). DEV runs a genuine Stripe TEST-MODE integration: a real Stripe Elements 'Payment Element' iframe, a Supabase edge function `authorise-booking` that server-side calculates the amount and creates a real manual-capture PaymentIntent (returning a client_secret), and `stripe.confirmPayment()` on the client. This was discovered empirically (diagnostic Cypress runs against the live app) after an earlier classification pass wrongly assumed no Stripe integration existed at all, based on the stale local source. See docs/features/stripe.md for the full writeup, verified request/response payloads, and the real `bookings` table schema (columns like stripe_payment_intent_id, stripe_status, stripe_refund_id, bond_stripe_intent_id, platform_fee, lender_payout_amount all genuinely exist and are server-computed).

automationStatusValues.automated: Has a real Cypress it() block in cypress/e2e/stripe/stripe-payment.cy.js, executed on every run, result auto-recorded.
automationStatusValues.planned: Genuinely automatable against current app behavior but not yet implemented (backlog) — Excel status set to 'Not Run', not faked as Pass.
automationStatusValues.blocked: Cannot be meaningfully automated or verified in this suite's scope (no webhook injection access, no client-triggerable refund flow found in the consumer app, no currency selection, undocumented business rule, or requires Stripe Dashboard/API access beyond the anon key). Excel status set to 'Blocked' with reason in Comments.

_meta.knownEnvironmentQuirk: The `authorise-booking` edge function intermittently returns HTTP 409 'Your saved selection expired. Please pick your dates again.' on a first submit attempt against a freshly-loaded checkout — observed during development, same flow/data succeeds immediately on a fresh reload+retry. Root cause not fully characterized (looks like a hold/reservation timing edge case in the DEV backend, not a bug in this framework). CheckoutPage.submitAndCaptureAuthorisation() retries ONCE automatically on a 409; a second consecutive 409 is treated as a real failure.
